Weight shares within a geoframe

Source: R/filter.R
geoscale_share.Rd

Normalised weights, either of the whole object or within each parent group.

Usage

geoscale_share(x, geoframe, weight = NULL, within = NULL)

Arguments

x

A Geoscale.

geoframe

Geoframe to report shares for.

weight

Weight column. NULL uses the default.

within

Optional coarser geoframe to normalise within. NULL normalises over the whole object.

Value

A data.frame with a code column named geoframe (matching the convention of recast_geoscale()), the weight, and share. When within is given, a column of that name carries the parent code.

Examples

gs <- geoscale_example()
geoscale_share(gs, "state", weight = "km2")
#>   state  km2     share
#> 1    N1  300 0.1428571
#> 2    N2  700 0.3333333
#> 3    S1 1100 0.5238095
geoscale_share(gs, "state", weight = "km2", within = "country")
#>   state country  km2 share
#> 1    N1       N  300   0.3
#> 2    N2       N  700   0.7
#> 3    S1       S 1100   1.0
